data.body_html:
Choosing between the Mangusta 80 and the Sunseeker Predator 55 for your Marbella charter is a matter of space, speed, and style. Both are premium open yachts that turn heads in Puerto Banús, but they suit different priorities. This guide breaks down the key differences — size, capacity, speed, and cost — so you can pick the right boat for your day on the Mediterranean.

Size & Deck Space

The Mangusta 80 measures 24 metres (79 ft) and offers a spacious flybridge, large sun pads, and a generous aft deck. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is 17.5 metres (57 ft) — still roomy for 12 guests, but with a more compact layout. If you want to host a party with dancing or lounging areas, the Mangusta wins. For a cosy, sporty feel, the Predator excels.

Speed & Performance

The Mangusta 80 is faster, with triple engines pushing it past 30 knots. The Predator 55 cruises at around 25 knots. Both handle the Costa del Sol swell well, but the Mangusta offers more thrilling acceleration. If speed matters, go Mangusta.

Passenger Capacity

Both yachts carry up to 12 passengers. The Mangusta 80 has more deck area, making it better for groups that want to spread out. The Predator 55 is more intimate, with seating that encourages conversation. Both are ideal for groups of 8–12.

Charter Pricing

The Mangusta 80 charter starts at €4,719 for 4 hours, with a free jet ski included. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is priced on request — typically lower, but without a jet ski. Both include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. For a fixed-price deal with extras, the Mangusta is better value.

Inclusions & Extras

Every charter from Boat Rental Marbella includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% Spanish VAT. The Mangusta 80 adds a jet ski. The Predator can be upgraded with toys on request via WhatsApp.

Which Yacht for Which Group?

Choose the Mangusta 80 if you want: maximum deck space, high speed, a jet ski, and a party vibe. Choose the Sunseeker Predator 55 if you prefer: a sportier design, a more intimate setting, and a lower budget. Both are excellent for cruising from Puerto Banús to Cala del Faro, Cabopino, or Estepona.

Frequently asked questions

Which is bigger: Mangusta 80 or Sunseeker Predator 55?

The Mangusta 80 is significantly larger at 24m (79ft) compared to the Sunseeker Predator 55 at 17.5m (57ft). This gives the Mangusta more deck space, a larger flybridge area, and better stability at sea.

How many guests can each yacht hold?

Both yachts can carry up to 12 passengers. The Mangusta 80 is ideal for larger groups wanting more space, while the Predator 55 offers a more intimate layout for the same number of guests.

What is the price difference for chartering these yachts?

The Mangusta 80 has a fixed rate from €4,719 for 4 hours (includes a jet ski). The Sunseeker Predator 55 is priced on request via WhatsApp. Typically, the Predator is slightly cheaper due to its smaller size.

Which yacht is faster?

The Mangusta 80 is faster, with a top speed of over 30 knots thanks to its triple engine setup. The Sunseeker Predator 55 cruises at around 25 knots. For speed enthusiasts, the Mangusta wins.

Do both yachts include a jet ski?

Only the Mangusta 80 includes a jet ski in its charter price. The Sunseeker Predator 55 does not, but you can request one as an add-on via WhatsApp when booking.

Which yacht is better for parties?

The Mangusta 80 is better for parties due to its larger deck area, flybridge lounge, and generous sun pads. The Predator 55 is more suited to relaxed cruising with a sporty edge.

Where do the charters depart from?

The Mangusta 80 departs from Puerto Banús. The Sunseeker Predator 55 typically departs from Marbella Marina or Puerto Banús. Both locations offer easy access to the Costa del Sol's best spots.

Which yacht should I choose for a Marbella day trip?

Choose the Mangusta 80 if you want maximum space, speed, and a free jet ski. Choose the Sunseeker Predator 55 if you prefer a sportier, more compact open yacht. Both are excellent for cruising to Cabopino or Estepona.
